# Templatical

> Embeddable drag-and-drop email editor SDK: JSON templates in, MJML out, framework-agnostic, with your own backend behind every storage feature. Source-available (FSL-1.1-MIT): free for commercial embedding, no license key, MIT two years after each release. Renderer, importers, types, quality linter and CLI are MIT today.

- Install: `npm install @templatical/editor`
- Agent Skill: `npx skills add templatical/sdk`

## Documentation

- [Docs index for agents](https://docs.templatical.com/llms.txt): every docs page with a one-line summary
